description: This file defines a DTMF (Dual-Tone Multi-Frequency) aggregation processor class for processing keypad input frames, aggregating sequences of DTMF digits, and converting them into transcription frames for downstream large language model (LLM) processing. It handles start, end, cancel frames, and input DTMF frames, with timeout-based flushing and special termination digit processing.

classes.name: DTMFAggregator
classes.description: A frame processor that aggregates DTMF keypad inputs into sequences and emits transcription frames, handling timeouts, termination digits, and control frames.

methods.name: __init__( self, timeout: float = 2.0, termination_digit: KeypadEntry = KeypadEntry.POUND, prefix: str = "DTMF: ", **kwargs, )
methods.description: Initializes the DTMF aggregator with optional timeout, termination digit, and prefix.

methods.name: None cleanup(self)
methods.description: Cleans up resources and stops background tasks.

methods.name: None process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, handling start, end, cancel, and DTMF input frames.

methods.name: _handle_dtmf_frame(self, frame: InputDTMFFrame)
methods.description: Handles an individual DTMF input frame, appending digits and checking for flush conditions.

methods.name: None _create_aggregation_task(self)
methods.description: Creates the background timeout-based aggregation task if not already created.

methods.name: _aggregation_task_handler(self)
methods.description: Background task that waits for digit events or timeouts to trigger flushing of accumulated DTMF digits.

methods.name: _flush_aggregation(self)
methods.description: Emits the current accumulated DTMF sequence as a TranscriptionFrame.
